What remains is one addition, which amendment B-517 (merged as pull request 363) homed in this task by adding pages/_routes.py and tests/helpers/page_client.py to the T7b file list: the single-use race defect of merged T7 code (two concurrent answers to one approval return 200 and 404 where spec 0006 AC30 requires 200 and 409, because the router fetches the screen before submit and a recorded request has no screen). REVIEWER: rounds 1 and 2 already approved the task at 7c944fb; judge the commits made after 7c944fb (the merge, the regression test, the fix) for correctness against spec 0006 AC30 and section 4.4, scope (files of the amended T7b list) and budget, and confirm that the earlier approved content is unchanged.
